correspondent_replies.rationale: Darwin asks specifically whether Gulliver examined other dog breeds beyond his published account. Gulliver identifies the Hewson dog as a mongrel and reports fox-hound and other good-breed examinations without marked differences. Chronology supports this narrow response; it does not identify every intervening query or answer the whole earlier letter.
correspondent_replies.response_scope: 1796 P4 dog-breed examination request answered by1632 P4; other sections remain unpaired.
